subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 2: Cubic Centimeters and Liters
description: Connect cubic centimeters and liters by converting between cube-based volume and container capacity.
learningObjectives: Explain why 1 liter is equal to 1000 cubic centimeters
Use the conversion to solve simple container and volume problems
Check whether conversion answers are reasonable
prerequisites: Know that volume is measured in cubic units
Know that capacity is measured in milliliters or liters
Multiply and divide whole numbers by 1000
